title: look for `.node` files in sibling directory.
author: nicksrandall
summary: Adds a third fallback in node/index.js to require `./lightningcss.<platform>.node` from the same directory, so a bundled lightningcss (esbuild copy loader, e.g. in AWS Lambda) can find a copied native addon. The diff no longer applies (index.js was restructured to `native = require(...)` and the WASM branch removed), but it's a 5-line change, so the real question is whether to support this layout at all.
evidence: devongovett 2023-04-18 asked why and noted the .node file comes from the platform package; author explained the esbuild/Lambda use case the same day; no maintainer reply since. Current node/index.js tries `lightningcss-${parts}` then `../lightningcss.${parts}.node` only. No related issues in the index.
decision: Should node/index.js add a fallback that loads `./lightningcss.<platform>.node` next to the bundled script, to support bundlers that copy the native addon (esbuild copy loader), or is installing the platform package the only supported layout?
